title: Show that the entry 17/8 zeros both directions of one far pair
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1,2}`, both far numerators of the pair `(4,8)` equal `(x - 17/8) / 512`. At `x = 17/8` the determinant is `81/64`, so both Schur directions are zero.
- The pairs `(3,7)` and `(3,8)` stay nonzero, so the bandwidth remains 4. The row gap rises to `5/2`. Corner entries and diagonals have no positive common root.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
